title: pyrus pangiensis
intro: Pyrus pangiensis, commonly known as Chinese mountain apple, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to offer various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its potential to treat cardiovascular diseases, fever, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus pangiensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
